test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow correctly enforces document checks and transitions through governance states as required by sponsor processes.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is installed and accessible
Test user accounts with Site Manager role created
Test study and site records configured
Required document templates uploaded to system

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS as Site Manager and navigate to Site Activation workflow for test site
test_steps.expected_result: System displays site activation dashboard with current status and pending document requirements

test_steps.action: Upload all required documents for site activation (protocol, IB, FDA 1572, etc.)
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts documents and updates status to show documents received and under review

test_steps.action: Submit site for activation approval through configured workflow
test_steps.expected_result: System routes approval request to designated approver and updates status to 'Pending Approval'

test_steps.action: Log in as approver and complete the approval with 21 CFR Part 11 compliant e-signature
test_steps.expected_result: System records approval with timestamp and electronic signature, transitions site to 'Activated' status

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow enforces all document requirements before approval
Workflow transitions correctly through all governance states
E-signature process complies with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements
Audit trail records all status changes and approvals
regulatory_basis: ICH E6 R2 trial management standards
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all document uploads and status changes
E-signatures must be securely linked to approver identity
Document version control must be maintained throughout process
